operator_path: From a clean checkout run the frozen offline suite plus the new domain tests. No network after dependency install.
must_scope: DRAFT revision 1 at Base e778a5246c4bec3f6a54aec2fdb315ab66ca756e. Phase 01 P1-P5 apply. READY needs review and a Custodian worktree.

Create src/hermes_pipeline/domain/pipeline.py with frozen dataclasses PipelineState(status: Literal['UNCONFIRMED','OPEN','REJECTED'], revision: int, text: str), ConfirmRequirement(text: str), RejectRequirement(reason: str), RequirementConfirmed(text: str), RequirementRejected(reason: str), PipelineResult(state, outcome: Literal['ACCEPTED','EMPTY_REQUIREMENT','INVALID_TRANSITION'], event). Function apply(state, command) -> PipelineResult.

Initial state is PipelineState(status='UNCONFIRMED', revision=0, text=''). ConfirmRequirement from UNCONFIRMED with nonempty stripped text yields OPEN, revision+1, RequirementConfirmed. RejectRequirement from UNCONFIRMED with nonempty stripped reason yields REJECTED, revision+1, RequirementRejected. Empty or whitespace-only text/reason yields EMPTY_REQUIREMENT, unchanged state, event None. Any other pair yields INVALID_TRANSITION, unchanged state, event None.

Create src/hermes_pipeline/domain/clock.py with Protocol Clock.now() -> datetime. The evaluator must not import datetime.now or call Clock. Create src/hermes_pipeline/domain/errors.py exporting the outcome literals only.

Tests in tests/domain/test_pipeline_aggregate.py cover accept, reject, empty, invalid, and a Hypothesis property that sequences never leave {UNCONFIRMED, OPEN, REJECTED}. An import-boundary test forbids domain/pipeline.py from importing sqlalchemy, langgraph, sqlite3, pathlib, or hermes_pipeline.controller.
Do not modify counter_spike.py. Export new types from domain/__init__.py without removing the counter oracle.
out_of_scope: Persistence, ControllerPort wiring, projections, Outbox, leases
Project RBAC, Feishu, GitHub, Agent execution
Editing counter_spike.py or keep-marked persistence spikes
interfaces: src/hermes_pipeline/domain/clock.py: Clock Protocol unused by apply
prohibited_actions: Import I/O, SQL, LangGraph, or wall-clock now inside the evaluator
Commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, or alter remotes

compatibility: Windows and Linux unit tests required.
security: Domain treats command text as untrusted data and stores it only in memory.
documentation: Slice index points at this draft.

acceptance_criteria.observable_result: ConfirmRequirement and RejectRequirement from UNCONFIRMED with nonempty input transition exactly as specified.
Empty input and illegal transitions leave state unchanged and emit no event.
pipeline.py imports no I/O, SQL, LangGraph, or datetime.now.
Existing frozen offline suite still passes.

required_tests: Illegal transitions from OPEN and REJECTED
Hypothesis: status stays in the three-state set
demonstration: Unit tests show a confirmed fake requirement opens the pipeline and a second confirm is INVALID_TRANSITION with unchanged revision.

risks.description: Domain grows into the full Stage machine.
risks.mitigation: Only the three states and two commands are in scope.
risks.trigger: A PRD or Development transition is added.

stop_conditions: Implementation requires persistence or a new public Schema
The three-state fake aggregate is rejected
